description: This file defines a Python client class for interacting with the SonarQube API, providing methods to fetch project measures, search issues, and a placeholder for triggering analyses.

classes.name: SonarQubeClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with the SonarQube API, supporting fetching measures, searching issues, and placeholder for triggering analysis.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] search_issues(self, project_key: str, p: int = 1, ps: int = 50)
